name: AI Agents List

sources.title: Homepage — live AI agents directory (600+ tools, 25,000+ monthly visitors claimed), MCP servers, blog
Submit — free eligibility check; paid listing $29 Lifetime or $49 Launch Boost, one-time, refund if rejected

requirements: Working AI agent or agent-focused tool with a public website that clearly explains the product
Generic agencies, unrelated software, and inaccessible sites may not qualify
Free eligibility check (no card) screens the URL before payment; account created during the flow
Payment only after the site passes the check: $29 Lifetime Listing or $49 Launch Boost, one-time via Stripe
preparation: Website URL (the eligibility check is the first step)
Product details for the structured profile (description, capabilities/tags, category)
$29 or $49 budget — Launch Boost adds a permanent dofollow link plus 28 days of featured placement
workflow: Open https://aiagentslist.com/submit and paste the website URL
Run the free eligibility check (saved to your account)
Pass the check, sign in, add product details
Pick Lifetime ($29, 48h review) or Launch Boost ($49, 24h review) and pay via Stripe
Editor publishes; you can update the listing anytime after publication
watchFor: No free listing tier — 'check eligibility free' only screens; accepted submissions are paid
Only Launch Boost ($49) includes a dofollow link; Lifetime's link is standard (likely nofollow/unspecified)
Full refund promised if a paid submission fails editorial review
Self-reported stats (DR 40, 25k visitors) — independent verification not done
Site cross-promotes its own services ('Build with Us' agency work, Compound Context course)
countsAsLive: The tool appears at aiagentslist.com/agents/<slug> with a profile page and is browsable under its category
unknowns: Whether the standard Lifetime link is dofollow — only Launch Boost explicitly says dofollow
